question: dame los diez países de comercio con más volumen liquidado, con el volumen en euros
sql: SELECT country_code, SUM(gross_eur_minor) AS volume_eur FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN dim_merchant_current ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_id = dim_merchant_current.merchant_id WHERE dim_merchant_current.is_active = true GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY volume_eur DESC LIMIT 10
